Callout.Name: Illegal Dumping
Callout.Message: Van seen tipping waste on a back road.
Callout.Advisory: Van still on scene, one suspect, no weapons seen.

Script.Line: The van is still there and he is still unloading it.
That is builders waste. Rubble and plasterboard, the lot.
He has been at it twenty minutes with a wheelbarrow.

Lines.Approach: The van is still there and they are still unloading it. They have not seen anybody.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
